name: Place it in time
description: Drag events onto a timeline between fixed anchors. Graded by order and by how many years each one is off.

fields.name: prompt
fields.default: Drag each event to when it happened.
fields.description: Shown above the timeline (also the card's title in lists).

fields.name: events
fields.description: [{ "label": "ENIAC", "year": 1945 }, ...]. The card shows a random 5 of them each review.

fields.name: anchors
fields.description: Fixed events shown on the line: [{ "label": "WWII ends", "year": 1945 }].

fields.name: range
fields.description: [from, to] in years. Default: the events' span plus a margin.

fields.name: count
fields.description: How many events to place, 3 to 6.

fields.name: tolerance
fields.description: Years off that still count as right on.
